description: The SOURCE phrase of the RECORD KEY and ALTERNATE RECORD KEY clauses (ISO §2023:12.4.5.12.2 / §2023:12.4.5.6.2: record-key-name-1 SOURCE IS { data-name-2 } ...) - a key that is 'the concatenation of all occurrences of data-name-2 in the order specified' (§2023:12.4.5.12.4 GR2 / §2023:12.4.5.6.4 GR2), with the record-key-name word class (§2023:8.3.2.2.24) and its scope (§2023:8.4.6.2.4). ANSI X3.23-1985 prints RECORD KEY IS data-name-1 only, so the form is post-1985. THE EDGE IS DERIVED, NOT QUOTED (VCR row 7.36; the repo holds no 1985/2002/2014 text, ratified decision #1): Annex E (2014->2023) does not list it, so it predates 2023; the 2002-versus-2014 split is not derivable in-repo and takes the provisional 2002 edge rows 7.21/7.31 carry - the edge that never refuses a legal 2002 program. Annex A.3 item 40 makes the capability processor-dependent; this implementation provides it (kb/Work PB1099 Q1, owner rule R65). Gated in ONE place, VersionConformancePass.VisitRecordKeySourcePhrase - the one grammar rule both clauses share.
display: the SOURCE phrase of the RECORD KEY or ALTERNATE RECORD KEY clause
citation: ISO §2023:12.4.5.12.2 / §2023:12.4.5.6.2 (GR2: the key is the concatenation of data-name-2); a post-1985 form (derived: VCR row 7.36); §2023:12.4.5.12.4 GR2
vcr: RECORD KEY / ALTERNATE RECORD KEY SOURCE phrase (post-85; provisional 2002 edge); VCR row 7.36
